# The tree view rebuilds a missing prune boundary before removing rows

This landing clamps visible row indices and checks whether either prune boundary has an actual row node. If a boundary is missing, reset clears rendered rows and the row map before the fill routine re-enters; pruning does not dereference that missing node. The actual zero-row/hidden-view guard runs before range calculation. A new test deliberately removes a boundary row/cache entry and expects a contiguous rebuilt range. This is a local source/test contract, not an executed repair or global rendering guarantee. The required primary discussion remains incomplete and carries zero full-audit credit.

Scope: BaseTreeView row-buffer recovery.
